description: Re-encode an existing video for final delivery using a quality preset and output format. Use this for publishing-ready renders; use video_convert when the main goal is container/codec conversion. The source video is read only and a new output file is produced.

c2pa_manifest_path.description: Optional C2PA manifest definition JSON to sign the final mp4 export.
c2pa_manifest_path.title: C2Pa Manifest Path

format.description: Output format for delivery. Supported values are mp4, webm, gif, and mov.
format.title: Format

input_path.description: Absolute path to an existing local video file. The input file is read only.
input_path.title: Input Path

output_path.description: Destination video path. Auto-generated when omitted; an existing supplied path may be overwritten.
output_path.title: Output Path

quality.description: Delivery quality preset: low, medium, high, or ultra.
quality.title: Quality

name: video_export
title: Export video for delivery
